term.label: RNA_polymerase_promoter

definition.text: A region (DNA) to which RNA polymerase binds, to begin transcription.

comments: Term merged with promoter SO:0000167 in August 2020 as part of GREEKC initiative. See GitHub Issue 492 (https://github.com/The-Sequence-Ontology/SO-Ontologies/issues/492)

mostRecent.subject: Removed 'is_a' relationship line from RNA_polymerase_promoter, which was obsoleted back in August.
